source_hypotheses.constructed:
[1 Literal specification] The root recipe integers has one rational parameter and private existential blocks; sums of squares mean conjunction and products mean disjunction
[2 Index model] K0=Q(√2), d=75−53√2 and the displayed P0; 2E(K0)=ZP0 with unique five-coordinate point codes
[3 Height prerequisite] The foundation height theorem supplies H6(S_ht) for the original compiler and variable-shift proof
[4 Pole predicate] For B≠0, Φ(B) excludes negative odd valuations outside{2,3,5,7,13}; completeness requires square denominator,0<B<1/2 and local depths≥4
[5 Multiplication] The multiplication template conjoins membership of all three input codes in2E(K0), then uses the exact local tests and finite false-triple guard
[6 Restricted converse] For positive squarefree ell≡11 mod12, E_ell:y²=x(x−ell)(x+3ell); full2∞Selmer corank1 implies analytic order1
[7 Limit diagrams] Finite free models transport actual cochain/local-condition/duality diagrams for one fixed support; the inner limit retains all identities
[8 Compiler] Signed inputs decode(n,kappa,a,l,j); exact rational tests, capped arithmetic and decreasing loops implement the precision predicate
[9 Ordinary values and bounds] Close relates the same signed codes to the same precision coordinates; for each nonzero shift it approximates integer n and supplies the six local tests

[2 Theta transport] Preserve multiplier, character and cusp conventions

[4 Uniform selection] Keep the incoming represented families unchanged
[5 Integral Tate lattice] Prove integral finiteness before polarized automorphism finiteness

source_hypotheses.constructed:
[1 Unary theta] Odd λ extended by zero gives Fλ in S3/2(Γ0(4C²),λχ−4); squarefree J dilation has available level4C²J
[2 Theta transport] Coefficient conjugation is normalized at the fixed Tate marking; finite primitive twist gives ψν² and the good-prime Hecke eigenvalues
[3 GI assembly] The exact inverse-theorem target is assembled from the displayed degree/rank, factorization, symmetry and converse modules
[4 Uniform selection] An internal exhaustion of ordinary globally equivariant unit tests supplies one standard bound; finite pigeonhole fixes component/convention choices
[5 Integral Tate lattice] Degree discreteness and divisibility bound the integral endomorphism lattice; Rosati positivity then gives a finite compact-sphere intersection
[6 Marked descent] Finite étale markings, free action on arbitrary test schemes, regular-base projectivity, effective descent and dual base change are retained
[7 Picard norm] Use the internal finite-flat determinant-norm and relative Picard construction at its actual consumer
[8 CM reduction] A common good model extends the finite diagram; prime-to-q kernels, level subgroups and tangent character specialize compatibly
[9 Oriented correspondence] The maximal-order fixed-orientation class set is a Pic(O)-torsor; a nonempty equivariant reduction is bijective with the stated stabilizer weights
source_hypotheses.justification:
Dimension source_hypotheses: the following exact contract explanations address the mapped conditions. [1 Unary theta] Poisson proof retains the full dyadic divisor and fresh-prime omissions.
[2 Theta transport] Full-eigenspace proportionality and unit support remain earlier explicit inputs.
[3 GI assembly] The closure receipt establishes inclusion and bounded joins; it is not a reproof of every GI source.
[4 Uniform selection] This selects a lower test and does not promote arbitrary weak nilcharacters to strong ones.
[5 Integral Tate lattice] Rational finite rank alone is not used as a substitute for integral finite generation.
[6 Marked descent] Projectivity precedes duality; a norm ample bundle does not replace the polarization.
[7 Picard norm] No unsupported arbitrary proper-map norm is substituted.
[8 CM reduction] Class-index inversion is global; no arbitrary choices of isomorphisms are declared H-rational.
[9 Oriented correspondence] No nonmaximal-order or arbitrary-conductor generalization is inserted. Author normalization only; full original qualifications and evidence remain in the pinned contract. This status is not independent acceptance.
